thread:
maya: Heads-up — a Tier-1 customer asked for per-route quantization recommendations + auto-batching guidance. They want something they can see in the console and try in pilot. Should this be our top Optimize initiative for the next quarter?

samir: do we have data on potential impact? that determines priority. recommendations are low-friction but automation is infra-heavy.

elaine: from the PD calls: two asks keep coming up — (1) eval-triggered alerts for quality regressions, (2) actionable cost/perf recs (batch/cache/quant) surfaced per-route. customers want an "advice" panel, not a blackbox.

roberto: engineering note: continuous batching changes in runtime are mid-sprint work. if we push for auto-apply we need 2 full sprints + safety hooks. can we scope a read-only MVP?

maya: proposal: phased rollout. Phase 0 = offline recommender that reads evals + perf traces and produces human-readable recs in the console (no apply). Phase 1 = SDK + one-click apply that creates a canary rollout. Phase 2 = automated rollouts with fallback policies and eval-triggered alerts.

samir: +1 phased. important: Phase 0 needs reliable telemetry (per-token latency/cost, prefix hit rates). eng-runtime: can you surface that?

roberto: runtime can ship token-level summaries but requires a small schema change and a short exporter (3w estimate). also need KV-cache hit telemetry.

anika: devex: we'll need SDK hooks and quickstart samples in Phase 0 so partners can consume recs programmatically. docs + sample app -> 1 week after Phase 0 cut.

prod-bot: poll created by maya: "Approve phased plan (Phase0->Phase2)" — options: Yes / Need changes. Voting open 48h.

roberto: suggested launch criteria for Phase 1 pilot: either cost reduction >=10% for top 20% of pilot workloads OR eval alerts triggered for >=5 pilot customers within 30 days. also require zero SLO regressions during canary.

maya: agree with that gate. add requirement: fallback to model baseline within 5m of any alert.

samir: risk callout: quant recs often trade quality for perf. we must pair recs with eval harnesses and preflight checks. recommend an "acceptance test" that runs sample prompts and compares embedding/text metrics before applying.

elaine: product-side acceptance criteria: (a) recs explain expected unit-cost savings and quality risk, (b) one-click report summarizing pre/post evals for the customer, (c) audit log entries for every recommendation and action.

maya: action items: maya -> PRD draft by Tue EOD; roberto -> telemetry estimate by Mon EOD; anika -> SDK hooks sketch by Wed; ops-team -> shortlist 6 pilot customers and share contacts by Fri. i'll post PRD link here when ready. please react with :thumbsup: if you endorse the phased approach or comment if not.

samir: :thumbsup: but add explicit QA window for quant recs.

roberto: :thumbsup: will confirm exact effort after scoping.

anika: noted. will include a sample CLI for applying recs in the SDK sketch.

maya: thanks — ping me if you need customer quotes for the PRD.
